source.verse_hash_method: SHA-256 of exact tab-separated Greek payload, retaining whitespace and variant markers.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps weekly individual saving and proportional means.
key_decisions.before: On the first day of every week, each person of you is to put something aside, storing up as he may prosper, so that no collections be made when I come.
key_decisions.after: On the first day of every week, each of you should set something aside and save it, in keeping with whatever prosperity you have, so that collections will not be made when I come.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: On the first day of every week, each one of you is to put something aside, storing up as he may prosper, so that no collections be made when I come.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves community-approved couriers and gift destination.
key_decisions.before: And when I arrive, whomever you approve, I will send with letters to carry your gift to Jerusalem;
key_decisions.after: Then when I arrive, I will send those you approve with letters to carry your gracious gift to Jerusalem.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And when I arrive, whomever you approve, I will send with letters to carry your gift to Jerusalem;

key_decisions.before: for a wide door has opened for me for effective work, and there are many adversaries.
key_decisions.after: for a great and effective door has opened for me, and there are many opponents.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: for a wide door has opened for me for effective work, and there are many adversaries.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps Apollos's independent refusal and future openness.
key_decisions.before: Now concerning Apollos the brother, I strongly urged him to come to you with the brothers and sisters; but it was not at all his will to come now, but he will come when he has opportunity.
key_decisions.after: Now concerning our brother Apollos: I strongly urged him to come to you with the brothers, but it was not at all his will to come now. He will come when he has an opportunity.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Now concerning Apollos the brother, I strongly urged him to come to you with the brothers; but it was not at all his will to come now, but he will come when he has opportunity.

key_decisions.rationale: Retains four terse imperatives and gendered idiom's courage sense.
key_decisions.before: Be watchful, stand firm in the faith, act like men, be strong.
key_decisions.after: Stay alert; stand firm in the faith; be courageous; be strong.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Be watchful, stand firm in the faith, act like men, be strong.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves household, geography, self-devotion, and continuing appeal.
key_decisions.before: Now I urge you, brothers and sisters—you know the household of Stephanas, that it is the firstfruits of Achaia, and that they have devoted themselves to service for the holy ones—
key_decisions.after: Now I urge you, brothers and sisters—you know the household of Stephanas, that they are the firstfruits of Achaia and have devoted themselves to serving the saints—
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Now I urge you, brothers—you know the household of Stephanas, that it is the firstfruits of Achaia, and that they have devoted themselves to service for the holy ones—

key_decisions.before: that you also be subject to such people and to everyone who works and labors with them.
key_decisions.after: submit yourselves to such people and to everyone who works and labors with them.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: that you also be subject to such people and to everyone who works and labors with them.

key_decisions.rationale: Retains curse and untranslated Aramaic plea.
key_decisions.before: If someone does not love the Lord, let him be accursed. Our Lord, come!
key_decisions.after: If anyone does not love the Lord, let that person be accursed. Marana tha!
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: If anyone does not love the Lord, let him be accursed. Our Lord, come!
